rationale.consistency: Good use of existing patterns, but duplicates a command execution loop (runGitCommands) instead of generalizing the one in pr/checkout.
rationale.edge_cases: Correctly handles mutually exclusive flags, blank paths, absolute path conversion, and scopes the fast-forward pull to the target worktree.
rationale.scope: Delivers exactly the requested features and extracts the shared helpers without unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: Control flow for flag validation and branch checkout logic is well-structured and easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: Safely resolves paths to absolute before processing and handles git fast-forward pull failures gracefully with a warning.
rationale.maintainability: Extracts worktree path validation cleanly to the shared package, though leaves some duplication in git command execution logic.
